entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Yes, um, I'm calling about... I think I need to return something? It's these cycling shoes I bought a while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
I think so... hold on. Okay, it's VF-98765. I'm just so lost with all this. I read some reviews and they seemed perfect, but they're not working for me at all.

Okay, I'm pulling up that order now. I see the VeloFit Sprinter Pro shoes, delivered on December 1st. To make sure I'm on the right track, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I... I don't know if it's technical? I tried setting up the cleats like the instructions said, but every time I ride I get awful blisters on my heels. They just feel wrong. The website was a bit confusing. Can't you just help me? I just want to send them back.
I'm very sorry to hear they're causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for you. Let me just pull up our return policy information for these shoes.
Okay... I just hope I can get a refund. I don't know what I'd do with them otherwise.
No problem at all. I've just checked our policy, and it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window for standard items. We can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief. So a full refund is possible?

Yes, absolutely. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. You should see it in your inbox shortly.
Wow, thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried and confused about what to do. You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could help clear things up. Is there anything else for you today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
